manual_ground_truth_accuracy: not measured; all matches remain estimates

road_crs_wkt: PROJCRS["ITRF_2000_UTM_K",BASEGEOGCRS["ITRF2000",DATUM["International Terrestrial Reference Frame 2000",ELLIPSOID["GRS 1980",6378137,298.257222101,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],ID["EPSG",6656]],PRIMEM["Greenwich",0,ANGLEUNIT["Degree",0.0174532925199433]]],CONVERSION["unnamed",METHOD["Transverse Mercator",ID["EPSG",9807]],PARAMETER["Latitude of natural origin",38,ANGLEUNIT["Degree",0.0174532925199433],ID["EPSG",8801]],PARAMETER["Longitude of natural origin",127.5,ANGLEUNIT["Degree",0.0174532925199433],ID["EPSG",8802]],PARAMETER["Scale factor at natural origin",0.9996,SCALEUNIT["unity",1],ID["EPSG",8805]],PARAMETER["False easting",1000000,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],ID["EPSG",8806]],PARAMETER["False northing",2000000,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],ID["EPSG",8807]]],CS[Cartesian,2],AXIS["easting",east,ORDER[1],LENGTHUNIT["metre",1,ID["EPSG",9001]]],AXIS["northing",north,ORDER[2],LENGTHUNIT["metre",1,ID["EPSG",9001]]]]
coordinate_operation: Inverse of unnamed + axis order change (2D) + Conversion from ITRF2000 (geog2D) to ITRF2000 (geocentric) + Inverse of WGS 84 (G1150) to ITRF2000 (1) + Conversion from WGS 84 (G1150) (geocentric) to WGS 84 (G1150) (geog2D) + Inverse of WGS 84 to WGS 84 (G1150) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
accident_to_road_operation: Inverse of Korea Unified Belt + KGD2002 to WGS 84 (1) + Inverse of ITRF_2000_To_WGS_1984 + axis order change (2D) + unnamed (with axis order normalized for visualization)

reverse_pairs.criterion: reversed node IDs, equal road name/rank/number/link_type, Hausdorff <=30m; geometric grouping remains an estimate
